proposals.before: When his coffin returned home, the Emperor ordered the third imperial son and Prince Zhuang Yunlu to attend the mourning, sent officials to escort the procession, granted state burial, and gave him the posthumous title Gongmin.
proposals.after: When his coffin returned home, the Emperor ordered the third imperial son and Prince Zhuang Yunlu to attend the mourning, sent officials to escort the procession, granted state burial, and gave him the posthumous title Gongque.
proposals.reason: Posthumous name 恭愨 is Gongque (愨 què), not Gongmin.

proposals.before: Censor Wei Tingpu memorialized that the old practice should be kept; Grand Secretariat of State Ceremonies Lin Lingxu also asked that a descendant of the Quzhou Kong line serve as Qufu magistrate. The matter was referred to the court for deliberation; Tingpu's view was adopted, and the Duke Yansheng was still to forward nominations while the provincial governor examined candidates and appointed by imperial topic.
proposals.after: Censor Wei Tingpu memorialized that the old practice should be kept; Director of the Court of State Ceremonial Lin Lingxu also asked that a descendant of the Quzhou Kong line serve as Qufu magistrate. The matter was referred to the court for deliberation; Tingpu's view was adopted, and the Duke Yansheng was still to forward nominations while the provincial governor examined candidates and filled the post by imperial appointment.
proposals.reason: 鴻臚寺卿 is Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, not Grand Secretariat; 題補 means filling a post by imperial appointment.

decisions.reason: s0033 ends with 諡恭愨. 愨 is què, so the posthumous name is Gongque; Gongmin misreads 愨 and is not supported by the Chinese.
The literal likewise renders 恭愨 as Gongmin; Gongque is the correct reading of 愨 què and matches the idiomatic repair.
s0099 has 諡莊愨. 愨 is què, so Zhuangque is correct; Zhuangmin is an unsupported misreading of the same graph.
The literal likewise misreads 莊愨 as Zhuangmin; Zhuangque restores the correct posthumous name.

鴻臚寺卿 is the Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, not a Grand Secretariat office; 題補 means filling the vacancy by imperial appointment, not 'appointed by imperial topic'. The proposed literal corrects both errors without inventing content.
